name: Takase Rin
source:
2nd year high school student.
[url=/c45742]Ritsu's[/url] younger twin sister and the protagonist's cousin.
A beautiful and smart woman. She's serious and methodical.
She never reciprocates when men approach her.
She's not very cooperative and is very cool around school, but she is surprisingly protective of the protagonist and often supports her.
